mapper.select: select predict_type, model_version, count(*) as prediction_count, avg(accuracy) as avg_accuracy, avg(rmse_error) as avg_rmse, avg(mae_error) as avg_mae, avg(confidence) as avg_confidence, min(predict_time) as first_prediction, max(predict_time) as latest_prediction from soil_prediction where predict_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) group by predict_type, model_version order by predict_type, model_version
